verses.text: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north; and he brought me to the chamber which [was] opposite the separate area and opposite the building toward the north.
verses.textZh: 他帶我出來向北，到外院，又帶我進入聖屋；這聖屋一排順著空地，一排與北邊鋪石地之屋相對。

verses.text: Along the length, [which was] a hundred cubits, [was] the north door; the width [was] fifty cubits.
verses.textZh: 這聖屋長一百肘，寬五十肘，有向北的門。

verses.text: Opposite the twenty [cubits] which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, [was] gallery corresponding to gallery in three stories.
verses.textZh: 對著內院那二十肘寬之空地，又對著外院的鋪石地，在第三層樓上有樓廊對著樓廊。

verses.text: Before the chambers [was] an inner walk ten cubits wide, a way of one [hundred] cubits; and their openings [were] on the north.
verses.textZh: 在聖屋前有一條夾道，寬十肘，長一百肘。房門都向北。

verses.text: Now the upper chambers [were] smaller because the galleries took more [space] away from them than from the lower and middle ones in the building.
verses.textZh: 聖屋因為樓廊佔去些地方，所以上層比中下兩層窄些。

verses.text: For they [were] in three stories and had no pillars like the pillars of the courts; therefore [the upper chambers] were set back from the ground upward, more than the lower and middle ones.
verses.textZh: 聖屋有三層，卻無柱子，不像外院的屋子有柱子；所以上層比中下兩層更窄。

verses.text: As for the outer wall by the side of the chambers, toward the outer court facing the chambers, its length [was] fifty cubits.
verses.textZh: 聖屋外，東邊有牆，靠著外院，長五十肘。

verses.text: For the length of the chambers which [were] in the outer court [was] fifty cubits; and behold, [the length of those] facing the temple [was] a hundred cubits.
verses.textZh: 靠著外院的聖屋長五十肘。殿北面的聖屋長一百肘。

verses.text: Below these chambers [was] the entrance on the east side, as one enters them from the outer court.
verses.textZh: 在聖屋以下，東頭有進入之處，就是從外院進入之處。

verses.text: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, facing the separate area and facing the building, [there were] chambers.
verses.textZh: 向南（原文是東）在內院牆裡有聖屋，一排與鋪石地之屋相對，一排順著空地。

verses.text: The way in front of them [was] like the appearance of the chambers which [were] on the north, according to their length so was their width, and all their exits [were] both according to their arrangements and openings.
verses.textZh: 這聖屋前的夾道與北邊聖屋的夾道長寬一樣；出入之處與北屋門的樣式相同。

verses.text: Corresponding to the openings of the chambers which were toward the south was an opening at the head of the way, the way in front of the wall toward the east, as one enters them.
verses.textZh: 正在牆前、夾道的東頭，有門可以進入，與向南聖屋的門一樣。

verses.text: Then he said to me, 'The north chambers [and] the south chambers, which are opposite the separate area, they are the holy chambers where the priests who are near to the LORD shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, the grain offering, the sin offering and the guilt offering; for the place is holy.
verses.textZh: 他對我說：順著空地的南屋北屋，都是聖屋；親近耶和華的祭司當在那裡吃至聖的物，也當在那裡放至聖的物，就是素祭、贖罪祭，和贖愆祭，因此處為聖。

verses.text: 'When the priests enter, then they shall not go out into the outer court from the sanctuary without laying there their garments in which they minister, for they are holy. They shall put on other garments; then they shall approach that which is for the people.'
verses.textZh: 祭司進去出了聖所的時候，不可直到外院，但要在聖屋放下他們供職的衣服，因為是聖衣；要穿上別的衣服才可以到屬民的外院。

verses.text: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faced toward the east and measured it all around.
verses.textZh: 他量完了內殿，就帶我出朝東的門，量院的四圍。

verses.text: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
verses.textZh: 他用量度的竿量四圍，量東面五百肘（原文是竿；本章下同），

verses.text: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds by the measuring reed.
verses.textZh: 用竿量北面五百肘，.

verses.text: On the south side he measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.textZh: 用竿量南面五百肘，

verses.text: He turned to the west side [and] measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.textZh: 又轉到西面，用竿量五百肘。

verses.text: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall all around, the length five hundred and the width five hundred, to divide between the holy and the profane.
verses.textZh: 他量四面，四圍有牆，長五百肘，寬五百肘，為要分別聖地與俗地。
